source.author: verg
source.text: Dextrum Scylla latus, laevum implacata Charybdis obsidet, atque imo barathri ter gurgite vastos sorbet in abruptum fluctus, rursusque sub auras erigit alternos et sidera verberat unda.
source.text_original: Dextrum Scylla latus, laevum implacata Charybdis / obsidet, atque imo barathri ter gurgite vastos / sorbet in abruptum fluctus, rursusque sub auras / erigit alternos et sidera verberat unda.
source.text_english: On the right flank Scylla lies in wait, on the left unappeased Charybdis, and from the abyss below she swallows the vast waves in a triple whirlpool down into the chasm, and then lifts them again alternately up into the air, and with her wave beats the stars.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Dextrum Scylla latus, laevum implacata Charybdis, Obsidet: si saxa fugimus, incurrimus in profundum: si contortos vortices evitamus, in saxa deferimur.
reuse.text_original: Dextrum Scylla latus, laevum implacata Charybdis, Obsidet: si saxa fugimus, incurrimus in profundum: si contortos vortices evitamus, in saxa deferimur.
reuse.text_english: On the right lies Scylla, on the left implacable Charybdis, besetting us: if we avoid the rocks, we rush into the deep; if we avoid the twisting whirlpools, we are carried onto the rocks.
